items.summary: Approved conditional hold. Do not queue duplicate allthingsmasonic.com comparison-block work while existing implementation is active or deployed. The hypothesis is technically feasible as a page-local reversible change, but it must wait for current work to clear and for the CFO’s bounded attribution/cost baseline. Preserve unknowns: causal lift, ROI, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, conversion value, and site-level commission are not established. After clearance, route only an isolated worktree change with focused tests, build, accessibility validation, page-only rollback, and a 14-day or 100-impression measurement window using available telemetry only.

The CFO report-only reconciliation is safe to enter the existing queue. It is read-only, isolated from production, reversible by withdrawing the work item, and does not request duplicate telemetry or invent attribution. Acceptance must explicitly identify known, unavailable, and conflicting fields and whether the retained experiment’s measurement contract is complete.
